mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the most important blood-group system in human-blood transfusion."
The ABO system is the most important blood-group system in human-blood transfusion.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a liver disease caused by the hepatitis B virus."
Hepatitis B (HBV) is a liver disease caused by the hepatitis B virus.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an inflammation (swelling) of the protective membranes covering the brain and spinal cord."
Meningitis is an inflammation (swelling) of the protective membranes covering the brain and spinal cord.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the process of introducing weakened or killed germs (vaccines) into the body, which increase body immunity to protect one from a particular disease."
Immunisation is the process of introducing weakened or killed germs (vaccines) into the body, which increase body immunity to protect one from a particular disease.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are those antigens that are presented by MHC class I or MHC class II molecules on the surface of tumor cells."
Tumor antigens are those antigens that are presented by MHC class I or MHC class II molecules on the surface of tumor cells.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an uninterrupted series of refrigerated production, storage and distribution activities, along with associated equipment and logistics, which maintain a desired low- temperature range."

An unbroken cold chain is an uninterrupted series of refrigerated production, storage and distribution activities, along with associated equipment and logistics, which maintain a desired low- temperature range.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a potentially serious infectious disease that mainly affects your lungs."
Tuberculosis (TB) is a potentially serious infectious disease that mainly affects your lungs.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the main function of the humoral immune system."
The production of antibodies is the main function of the humoral immune system.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are those that are entirely absent from the normal human genome."
Neo-antigens are those that are entirely absent from the normal human genome.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the wide varieties of methods and focused experimental protocols developed by immunologists for inducing, measuring, and characterising immune responses."
Immunological techniques are the wide varieties of methods and focused experimental protocols developed by immunologists for inducing, measuring, and characterising immune responses.
